body:
The current core desktop report completed on an Intel6975P-C runner with no configured desktop ceiling. The earlier calibrated EPYC Light failure therefore remains unresolved.

This temporary diagnostic runs the existing desktop measurement on the compatible Ubuntu22.04 runner image. It first requires all three desktop ceilings to exist for the actual CPU model and core count. An ineligible host fails before timing; an eligible host runs the unchanged stock `measure_still_frame.mjs --gate --only desktop` command, using Node22, Playwright1.56.1 and the canonical publisher.

Checkout is pinned to core candidate `1605dcbd4b58bedf98084a16d4b32d95a59bd20e`; the complete app tree is `b148a5508f0fce7169b905963180b4ac641ddc75`. This branch adds only the diagnostic workflow, targeting the held feature branch so its test stays separate from the dev candidate. The existing seven exact-head core CI workflows remain required, including the whole frame/memory grid. Measurements, samples, geometry, raster and limits are unchanged.

Repository AGENTS.md requires workflow changes in an interactive, owner-visible PR. This draft supplies that visibility. Close it unmerged after retaining the host eligibility and timing artifacts; it is never part of the app merge.
title: Diagnostic: obtain a calibrated desktop reading for Better Trees
head: diagnostic/t3747-calibrated-desktop
